shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੱਖੀ ਜੰਗਲ ਖਾਲਸਾ ਆਇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਲਗੋ ਨੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: la'khee ja(n)gal khaalasaa aai dheedhaar lago ne ||

en.bdb: In the Lakhee Jungle, the Khalsa heard of the coming of the Guru, and they longed to gain a sight of him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣ ਕੈ ਸੱਦ ਮਾਹੀ ਦਾ ਮੇਂਹੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਾਹੁ ਮਤੋ ਨੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: sun kai sa'dh maahee dhaa me(n)hee paanee ghaahu mato ne ||

en.bdb: Just as hearing the call of the herdsman, the water buffalo leave their water and feeding.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਨ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਕੋਈ ਸਉਕ ਪਿਯੋ ਨੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: kise naal na raleeaa kaiee koiee sauk piyo ne ||

en.bdb: In their joy, they all ran, each trying to pass the others to see their Beloved.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਾਕ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਿਤ ਮਾਹੀ ਤਾਹੀ ਸ਼ੁਕਰ ਕਿਤੋ ਨੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: giaa firaak miliaa mit maahee taahee shukar kito ne ||

en.bdb: Their anxieties were dispelled when they met their Herdsman, the Guru, and so in deep gratitude, they gave thanks.
